lines.1: 「We may as well adjust the sofa fittings too.」
lines.5: 「Are you calling me meticulous? You are simply too careless.」
lines.7: As she spoke, Otome slid under the sofa on her back this time.
lines.8: Now her legs stuck out from beneath it.
lines.10: Her trained, supple ankles were trim and beautiful.
lines.11: ...Maybe I really was a closet pervert.
lines.12: I pushed the stray thoughts away and focused on the work.
